note: Selection rule for the sprint validation run. Written before any T4 retrieval score. The test split is not an input to this rule.
mmrPoolReason: MMR reranks the top 50 items by fused score. NDCG@10 is decided inside that head. Items outside the pool keep fused-score order so R-precision can look past it.
alphaDefinition: Weight on the image signal. The text weight is 1 - alpha. A missing signal is not used; these arms always have both.
selection: Among hybrid arms at lambda 1, maximise macro NDCG@10. An exact tie breaks by preprocessOrder, then templateOrder, then fusionOrder, then alphaOrder. Then take the largest lambda whose macro intra-list diversity gain over lambda 1 is positive and whose macro NDCG@10 loss is at most 0.01. Otherwise lambda stays 1.
queryOrder: Images follow the committed split file. Paraphrases follow text-queries.v1.json. A hybrid arm loops images in that order and, within each image, the validation paraphrases of its class in file order.
hybridQueries: Each validation image is paired with each validation paraphrase of that image's class. The text query is the prompt template with {} replaced by the paraphrase. Relevance is the shared class.
textQueries: Each validation paraphrase, wrapped in the template, with no image.
imageQueries: Each validation image, with no text.
pixelQueries: Each validation image. raw and mean-centered are both reported. They are not selectable.
lexicalQueries: Each validation paraphrase wrapped in the template. Class-name tokens only. Not selectable.
diversitySpace: CLIP image embeddings of the arm's preprocess variant. Pixel arms use the pixel vectors of that arm. Intra-list diversity is 1 minus mean pairwise cosine of the top 10.
pairedComparisons: Paired intervals are computed only for arms that share a query list: the chosen hybrid arm against the other fusion at the same preprocess, template, and alpha, and the chosen lambda against lambda 1. Image, text, pixel, and lexical intervals stay unpaired because their queries are not the hybrid pairs.
